title: Coordenador(a) de Infraestrutura de TI | Holding
description:
Descrição da vaga

A pessoa Coordenadora de Infraestrutura será responsável pela área de infraestrutura de TI do Grupo Iter, garantindo alta disponibilidade, segurança, escalabilidade e eficiência operacional dos ambientes tecnológicos, suportando tanto as operações corporativas quanto os parques, além de liderar a evolução para um ambiente mais moderno, automatizado e resiliente (Cloud, DevOps e DR).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coordenar a equipe de infraestrutura de TI, promovendo organização, priorização, acompanhamento de entregas e desenvolvimento técnico do time;
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre infraestrutura, demais áreas de TI e áreas de negócio;
  • Planejar capacidade, melhorias contínuas e evolução tecnológica do ambiente;
  • Gerir ambientes de Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO, Backup, Wi‑Fi e serviços de rede;
  • Garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos ambientes on‑premises e cloud;
  • Monitorar ambientes, tratar incidentes, problemas e mudanças, garantindo aderência a SLAs;
  • Administrar e evoluir o ambiente Microsoft Azure, incluindo redes, VMs, storage, segurança e controle de custos;
  • Administrar Office 365 / Microsoft 365, incluindo identidade, acessos, políticas de segurança e colaboração;
  • Apoiar a definição de arquiteturas para novos projetos e soluções;
  • Estruturar pipelines, automações e boas práticas de DevOps, em parceria com times de desenvolvimento e sistemas;
  • Implementar e manter planos de Disaster Recovery, testes periódicos e documentação;
  • Apoiar projetos de expansão e novos parques, garantindo infraestrutura adequada (rede, conectividade, segurança e serviços);
  • Atuar no planejamento técnico e execução de projetos de infraestrutura.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida em infraestrutura de TI (on‑premises e cloud);
  • Conhecimentos avançados em:
    • Microsoft Azure e AWS
    • Active Directory / Azure AD
    • Office 365 / Microsoft 365
    • Redes (LAN/WAN/Wi‑Fi)
    • Backup e recuperação de dados
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas;
  • Experiência com gestão de ambientes críticos e alta disponibilidade;
  • Vivência na estruturação ou operação de práticas DevOps;
  • Experiência com ambientes de Disaster Recovery;
  • Conhecimento em ITIL (gestão de serviços de TI), boas práticas de gestão de serviços ou segurança da informação.

title: Senior Media Operations Manager
description:
Senior Media Operations Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers.
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Regulatory Science, or a related scientific discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in Scientific and Regulatory Affairs, Nutrition Science, Public Policy, or related functions within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), food, beverage, or other regulated industries.
  • Proven experience leading ingredient and nutrition advocacy and engaging effectively with government regulators, policymakers, and scientific communities.
  • Strong enterprise mindset with the ability to lead through influence in complex, matrixed, and multicultural environments.

title: Data Scientist [All Levels]
description:
About Us

Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our institutional page

Data Science at Nubank

Data Science is essential to every part of the business at Nubank, since Day 1. Most areas of the company use data science to some extent. Data Scientists are responsible for translating business needs into models and other types of data-driven solutions.

As a Data Scientist, you’re expected to

  • Interact with other team members to understand how to best apply data science and artificial intelligence to Nubank’s problems;
  • Investigate problems and discover insights through exploratory data analysis and other quantitative methods;
  • Have great numerical and analytical literacy, including knowledge of statistics and linear algebra as needed;
  • Work on multiple stages of the ML model lifecycle–from ideation to training and steady-state operation;
  • Work across multiple types of models, algorithms and learning paradigms;
  • Communicate technical points, decisions and tradeoffs to peers and stakeholders;

Our ideal candidate

  • Has experience working with ML models in a production environment;
  • Understands possible pitfalls and tradeoffs when applying ML to real‑world, sometimes messy problems;
  • Is familiar with the technical aspects of learning theory and algorithms and is able to discuss details if needed;
  • Has experience working with the Python scientific stack (Numpy, Pandas, Scipy, Sklearn, Boosted Tree Libraries, etc);
  • Has experience working with Tensor/Deep Learning libraries such as Tensorflow and Pytorch;
  • Is able to connect analytical outcomes to business priorities and advise stakeholders on the best course of action;
  • Has good communication skills and is able to convey technical topics and decision points to diverse audiences;
  • Has experience writing general‑purpose code using modern tools;
  • Understands the implications of causality when applying ML to problems;
  • Is up-to-date with recent developments in the area as a whole and is able to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation;

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale‑Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • 30 days of paid vacation

title: Venue Technology Manager
description:
Venue Technology Manager

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s)
  • Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders’ groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure
  • Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations)
  • Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process)
  • Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables
  • Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Commercial, Football Technology etc.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams
  • Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build-out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of tournament venues
  • In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services.
  • Identify and report on the progress of all critical dependencies in accordance with the reporting methodologies
  • Manage the asset tracking and management of deployed technology equipment
  • Track the progress of structural build-out and IT implementation leading up to the timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and final decommissioning of the venues
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems
  • Follow-up with various stakeholders, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring delivery of technology services / dependencies as per agreed requirements, service levels etc.
  • Support and ensure the team adhere to the IT Service management protocols
  • Ensure positive attitude from the Venue Technology teams and good relationship with all the parties, including FIFA teams, Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) areas/projects, end-users, suppliers, Host Country/ City counterparts
  • Manage the on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to Technology Command Centre.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry is a must
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and projects

Skills & Competencies

  • Manager with proven track record in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee.
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

title: Software Engineering Manager - Commerce (100% Remote - Brazil)
description:
About the job

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) is seeking a smart, creative, and hands-on Engineering Manager to lead a squad dedicated to our high-stakes Enterprise and Corporate B2B partners. You will be at the heart of our mission to revolutionize travel technology for global giants.

In this role, you aren't just a manager—you are a technical steward and a people multiplier . You will lead a high-performing team of talented engineers building complex, distributed systems that handle millions of transactions. You’ll navigate the intersection of technical excellence, enterprise-grade reliability, and the rapid “zero-to-one” pace that defines Hopper.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Hire, mentor, and coach a multidisciplinary squad. You’ll be responsible for building a high-trust culture where engineers are empowered to act like owners.

  • Partner closely with product teams to translate “big-picture” partner needs into executable technical roadmaps. You’ll ensure we ship high-quality features while managing the unique complexities of B2B integrations and public-facing APIs.

  • While you won’t be coding 100% of the time, you will stay deeply technical. You’ll lead architectural reviews, help unblock complex debugging sessions, and ensure our stack remains scalable and resilient.

  • Own the “run” of your team’s services. This means establishing on-call rotations, driving down technical debt strategically, and ensuring our systems meet the strict SLAs required by our enterprise corporate partners.

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for external partners. You must be able to explain complex system constraints to non-technical stakeholders and advocate for the best technical path forward. There may be some travel within North America for client meetings.

You are a perfect fit if you:

  • Have 2+ years of experience leading engineering teams and 7+ years in software development (ideally with JVM/Scala or React experience).

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and can build the “MVP” without sacrificing the long-term integrity of the system.

  • You have experience with microservices, distributed systems, and designing APIs that are robust enough for global enterprise use.

  • You prefer a “ship and iterate” approach. You can distinguish between what needs to be perfect on Day 1 and what can be optimized on Day 30.

  • You find more satisfaction in your team’s success than your individual commits. You have a proven track record of growing junior engineers into seniors and seniors into leads/architects.

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.

  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for the EOR-offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.

  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers

  • Very generous parental leave

  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.

  • Open communication with management and company leadership.

  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..

Como Gerente de Operações, você será responsável pela operação em uma Estação de Entrega, fornecendo liderança para Líderes de Equipe, Operadores e Prestadores de Serviços de Entrega, gerenciando relacionamentos e desempenho de agências externas. Você trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais semelhante a uma start-up do que a uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Se você tem um histórico focado na qualidade e obcecado pelo cliente, que carrega consigo a experiência de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, em constante mudança e ambíguo, adoraríamos ouvir sua opinião.

Responsabilidades:

  • Estar baseado em um de nossos postos de entrega. A Amazon opera 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, portanto, o trabalho em turnos fará parte dessa função, incluindo noites, finais de semana e feriados.
  • Supervisão da operação que foca na entrega de pedidos da Amazon direto aos clientes.
  • Apoiar sua equipe de líderes operacionais na gestão diária do posto de entrega, incluindo alocação de mão de obra, liderança de reuniões, atribuição de tarefas e comunicação com fornecedores internos e externos.
  • Trabalhar com KPIs como On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success e melhorar o atendimento ao cliente.
  • Pensar analiticamente sobre gerenciamento de projetos com atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de influenciar os outros e habilidades organizacionais excepcionais.
  • Ser obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para gerar melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal, utilizando habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas e comunicação para influenciar o público comercial e técnico.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante a implantação/implementação de novos sistemas/processos e coletar feedback.
  • Mapear requisitos de negócios, entender processos de negócios, estudar e analisar fluxos de trabalho e desenhar soluções.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações normais do dia a dia, garantindo que os associados tenham as ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos de Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

Qualificações:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience in people management
  • Work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Experience with e-commerce
  • Experience in project or program management

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Talent Partner
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior Talent Partner is a strategic thinker responsible for driving the talent acquisition strategy and execution across the organization. The role involves partnering with senior leadership to understand business needs, developing innovative recruitment strategies, and ensuring the acquisition of top-tier talent. The selected incumbent will lead complex recruitment initiatives and contribute to the overall talent management strategy. The partner is responsible for attracting, sourcing, and selecting top talent to meet the recruitment needs of Howard University. The selected incumbent will provide direct professional support in evaluating applicant work history, education, training, job skills, and other personal qualifications for positions within the university. The Talent Partner will collaborate with hiring managers senior talent acquisition management to create, develop and execute the appropriate recruiting strategies for executive level positions. The selected incumbent will partner with senior leadership to source and hire top executive and technical talent as the needs are identified to help support the university. The position reports to the Manager, Talent Acquisition.

Supervisory Authority

Not applicable

Nature And Scope

Contacts include interfacing internally with a diversified group of University staff. Externally, the incumbent interfaces with a variety of recruitment sources, a multi-cultural and diverse population, as well as professional organizations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Lead implementation efforts in executing position specific comprehensive recruitment strategies to ensure high-caliber talent is presented in selection pools
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen in joint partnership with senior leadership to understand workforce needs, and align recruitment efforts with specific organizational and departmental objectives
  • Interpret the position specific requirements and translate them into successful recruitment solutions and offerings
  • Evaluate applications, interview applicants, check references, and determine eligibility regarding qualification requirements for positions within the university under the direction of senior talent acquisition management
  • Identify, attract and introduce to university hiring managers, the best and most diverse talent in the marketplace by providing market intelligence
  • Initiate strategic recruitment and regular follow-up meetings with senior leadership and hiring managers to determine the effectiveness and status of the recruiting plans for each position
  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders, including senior executives, leadership, hiring managers, candidates, and external partners to create a partnership that yields success, predictable results and credibility of our talent acquisition infrastructure
  • Create a sourcing network through industry contacts, association memberships, professional conferences and hiring executives to help identify and source qualified candidates
  • Research, recommend, and leverage new sources for active and passive candidate recruitment efforts including the internet, social and professional networking sites
  • Provide a complete, accurate, and inspiring value proposition to potential candidates about Howard University, the specific department, and the corresponding available role
  • Implement ongoing creative and cost-effective sourcing strategies and initiatives
  • Review information received concerning position vacancy and leverage collaboration with hiring leadership in preparation for recruitment activities
  • Advise hiring managers if federal or local regulation and official human resources policies and procedures are aligned in their job description compliance review
  • Recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the long-term growth of the university, implementing new processes and fine-tuning standard procedures for recruiting to drive change
  • Review job vacancy requisitions for each corresponding department as assigned
  • Ensure all regulatory and compliance requirements for the federal government, the District of Columbia, and the Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) are met
  • Review references submitted by candidates, completes reference checks and records information received
  • Assess offer of employment letters for selected candidates and notifications of non-selection to ensure accuracy
  • Attend recruitment and talent acquisition seminars, job fairs, and professional organizational conferences to ensure the university is aligned in market trends, the evolving landscape of the higher education industry, and our competitive peer and aspirant institutions
  • Promote the university’s career opportunities to the professional and campus community via networking, job fairs, conference attendance and professional career events
  • Demonstrate the ability to handle a variety of recruitment issues with successful outcomes and demonstrating openness to new ideas
  • Keep abreast of new and updated standards and regulations related to recruitment
  • Perform other related duties as assigned by senior management

Core Competencies

  • Comprehension of current Equal Employment Opportunity laws and regulations as well as federal and local employment law guidelines
  • Lifecycle expertise in applicant tracking systems (e.g. Workday, PeopleSoft, etc.)
  • Excellent analytical, communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of current recruitment principles, procedures, techniques and practices
  • Ability to adhere to policy and procedural changes, and communicate the augmentation to each assigned department or client group
  • Possess a wide degree of creativity and business understanding of the higher education infrastructure
  • Critical thinking, active listening and keen capacity of professional judgment to discern clients’ recruitment needs, and influence hiring managers to provide sound recruitment advice to clients
  • Develop and maintain sourcing pools of highly competent candidates best matched to open job vacancies or future needs for the university
  • Ability to be a supportive and productive team member with a focus on providing professional customer service of the highest quality to applicants, candidates, hiring managers, and colleagues
  • Provide guidance and advisement to the Talent Operations Specialist role to ensure the Talent Partner’s job requisitions, candidate system and overall operational processing of each corresponding department’s positions are completed timely and accurately
  • Establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with faculty, staff, students and candidates
  • High level of professionalism and discretion in handling confidential information
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business or related area 5+ years of recruitment or talent acquisition related experience
  • 8 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications Experience in higher education desired
  • Full lifecycle recruitment experience preferred

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000

title: Creative Strategist (Performance Creative)
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our Al‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.
  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.
  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.
  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.
  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.
  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)
  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.
  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

title: FIFA Fan Festival Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The FIFA Fan Festival Manager will play support the operational delivery of the FIFA Fan Festival™ across all Host Cities in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working directly with the FIFA Fan Festival Senior Manager and the FIFA Fan Festival Team in Zurich, the role will help ensure consistent delivery across all Host Cities by supporting stakeholder coordination, infrastructure implementation and on‑site readiness. The position requires a detail-oriented and hands‑on professional with strong communication and project coordination skills, as well as the flexibility to adapt in a dynamic, large‑scale event environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning & Oversight Support

  • Assist the FIFA Fan Festival Senior Manager to steer the operational delivery of the FIFA Fan Festival.
  • Contribute to the implementation and roll‑out of the FIFA Fan Festival programme across Host Cities.
  • Support the development and delivery of operational documentation, site plans, and reporting.

Stakeholder Coordination & Support

  • Assist in managing relationships with key stakeholders including Host Cities, Host Countries and agencies.
  • Coordinate with local organisers to ensure the timely implementation of FIFA requirements.
  • Participate in meetings, workshops, and inspections with internal and external stakeholders.

Event Delivery & Infrastructure

  • Support the development of site design and technical infrastructure requirements.
  • Help monitor local delivery of core infrastructure and report on site readiness.
  • Oversee correct usage of FIFA's event marks and branding implementation in coordination with the Senior Manager.

Project & Team Coordination

  • Coordinate and support the sourcing, onboarding and supervision of local FIFA Fan Festival Venue Managers.
  • Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of progress, issues and milestones across multiple venues.
  • Assist in planning, documenting and executing site inspections, briefing sessions and operational weeks.

Reporting

  • Support the FIFA Fan Festival Senior Manager in adapting to changing project scopes and resolving issues.
  • Contribute to identifying risks and developing contingency plans.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Languages

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Project Management or a related field.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (spoken and written).

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
  • Strong digital and documentation skills.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in operational marketing, project delivery or event management, ideally in a sports context.
  • Previous engagement with governmental or municipal stakeholders is a plus.
  • Understanding of the dynamics of large-scale public or sports events.

Core Competencies

  • Highly self‑motivated with the ability to work independently within a structured team.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy across multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Advanced communication and documentation skills, with a proactive follow‑up mindset.
  • Resilient under pressure, with a high level of flexibility and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and travel frequently across Host Cities.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Especialista de Inteligência de Mercado - Shipping
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento.

Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado.

Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade.

O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também.

Porque na Norsul, pertencer é saber que sua atuação ajuda a sustentar um negócio essencial para o país — e uma cultura feita por gente que se importa.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS

Análise de Mercado e Definição de Estratégias de Afretamento

  • Realizar análises do mercado de cabotagem e internacional de granéis secos e líquidos.
  • Fornecer subsídios para a tomada de decisão comercial, de afretamento e de compra/venda de embarcações.

Análise de Resultados

  • Monitorar e avaliar a performance de contratos e viagens, comparando resultados obtidos com os planejados.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a área de operações, oferecendo suporte para otimização de desempenho.

Estratégia de Hedge de Aluguel de Navios (FFA) e Bunker

  • Desenvolver estratégias de proteção contra flutuações nos preços de aluguel de navios e combustível (bunker).

Operações de Hedge

  • Executar ordens de hedge e apoiar a avaliação da exposição ao risco.
  • Garantir a efetividade das operações de hedge conforme objetivos e métricas da empresa.

Orçamento e Projeção

  • Elaborar orçamento e projeções comerciais, alinhando metas e estratégias corporativas.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Conhecimento de Mercado: Conhecimento do mercado de shipping internacional, com foco em granéis sólidos.
  • Perfil Analítico: Domínio de Excel; conhecimento em Python e plataformas de trading será considerado diferencial.
  • Gestão de Risco: Experiência na identificação e mitigação de riscos relacionados à volatilidade de preços de frete e aluguel de navios; entendimento de contratos futuros, opções e estratégias de hedge.
  • Análise Técnica: Familiaridade com leitura e interpretação de gráficos de preços e indicadores do setor de shipping.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Benefícios que oferecemos

  • Plano de saúde e odonto
  • Wellhub (atividade física e bem-estar)
  • Atendimento psicológico (Telavita)
  • Nutricionista
  • Shiatsu
  • Ticket alimentação/refeição
  • Cultura de desenvolvimento contínuo
  • Programas internos de reconhecimento e cuidado
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day off de aniversário
  • PLR

Fazer parte

É mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer.

Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias.

Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.

A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto.

Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor.

Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega.

Se esse jeito de trabalhar faz sentido pra você, o próximo embarque pode ser o seu!

title: Associate Linux Support Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Associate Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. This role is an opportunity for a hands‑on engineer with eagerness to learn, a passion for Linux and open source technologies to work with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex cloud environments, desktop and server issues, Linux kernel crashes we've never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and customers. You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full technical stack at Canonical, across cloud, desktop and IoT. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. This is a globally remote role.

Location: This is a globally remote role.

The role entails

  • Working from your remote home office to provide technical support for employees.
  • Being available to take ownership of new cases via telephone, email and web.
  • Acting as an internal customer advocate keeping them updated in a timely manner.
  • Ensuring that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
  • Contributing new knowledge base articles and maintaining existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
  • Drafting and distributing technical notices for internal and external communication.
  • Prioritising your work in order to accomplish the most important and urgent tasks first.
  • Keeping on learning as our products and services grow and evolve.
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix.
  • Maintaining regular communication and information exchange with the rest of the team, locally and remotely.
  • Identifying and suggesting any opportunities to provide a better service.
  • Participating in a regular weekend working rotation.

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path. Preferable majors: Computer Science, MIS, Electrical Engineering, etc.
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation.
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results.
  • Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files).
  • Knowledge or basic hands‑on experience on 2 or more of:
    • Linux server administration
    • Programming fundamentals in any language (bash, Perl, Ruby, Javascript, C or C++, Go)
    • Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.)
    • Virtualization / Cloud computing concepts (provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.)
  • Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi‑cultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long.

Noting that we require and will perform a background check for this role.

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Experience supporting virtualized environments (KVM, Virtual Box, VMWare).
  • Experience with other open‑source desktop technologies.
  • Active contribution to open-source projects/forum/code.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Technology Product Manager

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Technology Product Manager works closely with the Business Stakeholders and the FIFA Products & Business Engagement team to define the product vision and roadmap for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

In this context, the Technology Products Manager serves as the primary liaison between the Business Stakeholders and FIFA Technology and is responsible for the planning and delivery of all Product within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 portfolio.

The Technology Product Manager is responsible for ensuring that the stakeholder’s needs and expectations are met.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Be accountable for the complete lifecycle of the Products in scope; Including delivery, operations, and release planning.
  • Establish and maintain a trust relationship with the Business Stakeholders.
  • Ensure proper alignment between the FIFA HQ and FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Create and agree together with the Business Stakeholders a Product long-term vision, roadmap, and strategy.
  • Build and maintain Product awareness and coordinate the Product Roadmap across Products.
  • Create and maintain the Product backlog according to the priorities given by the Business Stakeholders.
  • Lead the Product Backlog delivery ensuring continuous acceptance from the business throughout the delivery.
  • Ensure the Product delivers high-quality User Experience.
  • Understand the Product requirements and propose innovative solutions.
  • Facilitate the engagement and coordination of all Technology capabilities, as well as the non-IT areas involved, during the Product Lifecycle, such as IT Architecture, IT Security, Legal, Procurement, Branding, among others.
  • Facilitate and drive the actions that lead to the definition of the Product budget, as well as ensuring its efficient management and utilization throughout the Product Lifecycle.
  • Identify risks relevant to the Product and propose risk treatment strategies.
  • Plan and run regular Product Board meetings.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in computer science, Engineering or equivalent professional experience.

Qualification

  • Solid technical background with understanding or hands-on experience in software development/implementation.
  • In-depth knowledge of various delivery methodologies: such as Agile, in particular Scrum.
  • Proven record of successful deliveries of various complexities within Global and Multi-cultural organizations.
  • Experience with working close to UX/UI designer and development teams.
  • Experience in requirements gathering for web applications and subsequent translation of requirements in user stories.
  • Be familiar with hands-on operations in a highly demanding environment.
  • Good knowledge of Azure DevOps (or other backlog management tools).
  • Good knowledge of IT Service Management and Change Management, and solutions that support that capability (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Good knowledge of Power BI or other data analytics solutions
  • Strong experience in Service Management and ITIL Framework is an asset.

Experience

  • At least 8+ years of proven work experience in similar roles; ideally, within Delivery areas or related.
  • Proven work experience as a Product Manager / Product Owner for at least 5 years within the IT field.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent teamwork and leadership skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, and active listening communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Conflict resolution skills are a must.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Proven ability to manage teams remotely.
  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High sense of accountability, trustworthiness, and ethics.
  • Customer and results oriented.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Certification on one or more of different delivery methodologies, e.g., Professional Scrum Product Owner, Scrum Master, PMI-PMP, PMI-ACP is an asset.

Job Description Summary:

At The Coca‑Cola Company, insights power growth. As Sr. Director I, Consumer & Shopper Insights – Mexico & Brazil, you will lead the generation and activation of consumer, shopper, and category insights across two of the Company’s most critical and complex markets. Mexico and Brazil represent diverse consumer cultures, highly fragmented retail ecosystems, strong Traditional Trade, rapidly evolving digital behaviors, and significant affordability and executional dynamics. This role is accountable for translating deep human understanding, advanced analytics, and category foresight into strategies that drive market share, profitability, and long‑term brand relevance across both markets.

You will serve as a senior insights leader and strategic thought partner to Marketing, Commercial, Strategy, and Bottling System leadership, while maintaining strong connectivity with the LATAM and Global Insights networks.

What You’ll Do for Us

  1. Lead the Consumer & Shopper Agenda for Mexico and Brazil
    • Own the integrated Consumer & Shopper Insights strategy for both markets, aligning to local priorities, category needs, and global frameworks.
    • Provide thought leadership across categories and channels—Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, On‑Premise, eCommerce—grounded in local behaviors and tensions.
  2. Translate Human Understanding Into Business Guidance
    • Act as the single point of accountability for consumer, shopper, and category insights, ensuring consistency in frameworks while keeping them locally relevant.
    • Turn human motivations, barriers, and behaviors into actionable recommendations for marketing, commercial, and innovation teams.
    • Influence decisions on portfolio strategy, execution priorities, media focus, and recruitment strategies through insight‑driven narratives.
  3. Bring Analytical Excellence and Next‑Gen Insight Capabilities
    • Integrate multiple data sources—syndicated, shopper card, bottler, first‑party digital, and proprietary research—to deliver coherent, holistic insights.
    • Apply next‑gen insight capabilities—developed in partnership with the LATAM Human Insights team—leveraging AI/ML models, predictive analytics, behavioral science, and digital intelligence to translate signals into actionable business opportunities.
    • Leverage digital ethnography, social listening, sentiment AI, and cultural intelligence to detect emerging behaviors and whitespace opportunities.
  4. Lead, Inspire, and Build Capability
    • Drive a culture of curiosity and learning across the system, acting as the clear, influential voice of the consumer and shopper to senior leadership and bottler partners.
  5. Contribute to the Regional Human Insights Network
    • Share learnings, frameworks, and best practices with the LATAM Insights organization to enhance regional capability.
    • Bring country‑level trends, signals, and insights to the OU to inform broader strategic decisions.
    • Represent Coca‑Cola as a thought leader in consumer and shopper understanding, internally and externally when appropriate.

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Ticketing Customer Relations Senior Manager is responsible for supporting the definition and implementation of the comprehensive Ticketing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) strategy in close collaboration with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management. Serving as the primary liaison in the host country, this role oversees the entire Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country, providing mentorship and direction and ensuring that all managers and staff meet established objectives throughout the project lifecycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reporting operationally to the Team Lead Ticketing CRM, acting as the primary Ticketing CRM liaison in the Host Country with FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project.
  • Overseeing and managing the performance of the Ticketing CRM team in the Host Country through the implementation of effective processes, KPIs, service levels, escalation paths, and quality‑assurance plans.
  • Coordinating with other ticketing teams and FIFA functional areas to ensure cohesive and effective project delivery.
  • Handling all types of escalations with a solution‑oriented approach, ensuring efficient resolution of complex cases while keeping FIFA Global Headquarters and Senior Management informed.
  • Leading the identification, mitigation, and resolution of risks and issues and responding to major customer‑impacting incidents to minimise operational impact and reputational risk.
  • Ensuring the effective delivery of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy, including ticketing rules, policies, procedures, pricing, and ticket products, in line with legal requirements and ticketing objectives, ensuring fair and transparent access to tickets for as many fans as possible.
  • Overseeing sales data and demographic analysis to support the ongoing refinement of the overall Ticket Sales Strategy.
  • Translating the overall Ticketing Strategy into clear, actionable requirements that guide delivery across all Ticketing CRM functional areas.
  • Ensuring an efficient and optimised customer experience by defining and implementing the end‑to‑end customer journey for both general public and group sales customers, identifying service gaps, and implementing improvements across all channels.
  • Planning and implementing effective customer care for all ticketing customers, including organising and implementing automated customer‑care solutions for general public customers and ensuring high‑quality one‑to‑one support for both general public and group sales customers.
  • Ensuring full compliance with data protection laws, ticketing rules, terms, legal requirements, and internal policies, including the enforcement of internal control measures and access‑control policies.
  • Managing RFPs and service provider relationships to ensure external partners are contracted in a timely manner and meet all obligations related to service quality, processes, and customer data.
  • Overseeing Ticketing CRM reporting on customer care performance and trends, using data insights to enhance proactive communication and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Planning and delivering all ticketing sales collaterals and communications, and overseeing customer communications by planning, approving, and coordinating emails, notifications, FIFA.com content, FAQs, and manuals, ensuring mandatory legal documents are accurately presented and that tone and accuracy are consistently maintained, while ensuring proactive communication reduces the need for one‑to‑one support.
  • Ensuring the effective gathering of requirements for ticketing systems and communication channels and overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to guarantee system performance and readiness.
  • Ensuring effective communication channels for proactive communication and customer care for both general public and group sales customers.

YOUR PROFILE

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in large scale customer relations management within complex, high‑volume ticketing or major event environments; demonstrates strong leadership capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast‑paced, multicultural, and highly regulated environment.

Key requirements include:

  • Significant experience in customer service or ticketing operations within sports organisations or other high‑volume environments.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise, plan, and deliver under pressure and within tight timelines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders, including headquarters‑level entities, service providers, and technical teams.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The ideal candidate will bring experience in some of the following areas:

  • Expertise in defining CRM strategies, customer journeys, and service delivery frameworks to optimise the end‑to‑end customer experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex customer issues and coordinate cross‑functional responses to high‑impact incidents.
  • Solid understanding of data protection requirements and internal accountability processes to ensure full compliance with legal and operational standards.
  • Proficiency in managing RFPs and service‑provider relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret performance trends and translate data insights into actionable operational improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to oversee customer‑facing content, ensure accuracy and consistency, and support proactive communication strategies.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver complex workstreams within tight timelines.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders, demonstrating cultural awareness and high levels of discretion.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, communication channels, and User Acceptance Testing processes.

Para te ajudar a entender este desafio, aqui estão algumas responsabilidades:

  • Construção de Pipelines de Dados: Desenvolver, otimizar e manter pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) robustos, eficientes e escaláveis, utilizando o ecossistema Azure Databricks, incluindo Databricks Jobs e Delta Live Tables (Pipelines);
  • Otimização e Performance: Otimizar a performance de queries complexas e processos de ingestão e transformação, garantindo o processamento eficiente de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para o time de dados, promovendo as melhores práticas de engenharia, governança e qualidade de dados, mentorando o time de Dados;
  • Monitoramento e Qualidade: Implementar e manter rotinas de monitoramento que garantam a saúde, a consistência e a qualidade dos nossos pipelines e bases de dados;
  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento em Data Mesh: Liderar a concepção e ser o guardião técnico de domínios de dados específicos, garantindo a qualidade, disponibilidade, segurança e documentação dos "produtos de dados";
  • Governança de Dados: Implementar e disseminar estratégias de governança de dados dentro do time, incluindo conhecimento de todos os domínios de dados, garantindo a conformidade e a segurança das informações acessadas;

  • Disseminação da Cultura Data-Driven: Agir como um evangelista de dados, auxiliando as áreas de negócio a compreender e utilizar os dados disponíveis para tomar decisões mais inteligentes.

Para esta oportunidade, é necessário que você:

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados, atuando em ambientes de Big Data;
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com a plataforma Databricks no ambiente Azure (ADB), dominando seu principais componentes como Databricks JOBs, Delta Live Tables, e integração com Azure Data Lake Stirage (ADLS);
  • Domínio avançado de Python e SQL para manipulação e processamento de dados em larga escala;
  • Experiência avançada com Apache Spark / PySpark, incluindo otimização de jobs e performance;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados (Dimensional, Data Vault) e arquitetura de dados;
  • Compreensão profunda e vivência prática com os conceitos e a implementação de arquiteturas Data Mesh;

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento de código, como Git;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e mentoria.

É um diferencial se você possuir:

title: Senior Director, Consumer & Shopper Insights Brazil, LATAM
description:
Overview

At The Coca‑Cola Company, insights power growth. As Sr. Director I, Consumer & Shopper Insights – Mexico & Brazil, you will lead the generation and activation of consumer, shopper, and category insights across two of the Company’s most critical and complex markets. Mexico and Brazil represent diverse consumer cultures, highly fragmented retail ecosystems, strong Traditional Trade, rapidly evolving digital behaviors, and significant affordability and executional dynamics. This role translates deep human understanding, advanced analytics, and category foresight into strategies that drive market share, profitability, and long‑term brand relevance across both markets. You will serve as a senior insights leader and strategic thought partner to Marketing, Commercial, Strategy, and Bottling System leadership, while maintaining strong connectivity with the LATAM and Global Insights networks.

What You’ll Do for Us

  1. Lead the Consumer & Shopper Agenda for Mexico and Brazil
    • Own the integrated Consumer & Shopper Insights strategy for both markets, aligning to local priorities, category needs, and global frameworks.
    • Provide thought leadership across categories and channels—Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, On‑Premise, eCommerce—grounded in local behaviors and tensions.
  2. Translate Human Understanding Into Business Guidance
    • Act as the single point of accountability for consumer, shopper, and category insights, ensuring consistency in frameworks while keeping them locally relevant.
    • Turn human motivations, barriers, and behaviors into actionable recommendations for marketing, commercial, and innovation teams.
    • Influence decisions on portfolio strategy, execution priorities, media focus, and recruitment strategies through insight‑driven narratives.
  3. Bring Analytical Excellence and Next‑Gen Insight Capabilities
    • Integrate multiple data sources—syndicated, shopper card, bottler, first‑party digital, and proprietary research—to deliver coherent, holistic insights.
    • Apply next‑gen insight capabilities—developed in partnership with the LATAM Human Insights team—leveraging AI/ML models, predictive analytics, behavioral science, and digital intelligence to translate signals into actionable business opportunities.
    • Leverage digital ethnography, social listening, sentiment AI, and cultural intelligence to detect emerging behaviors and whitespace opportunities.
  4. Lead, Inspire, and Build Capability
    • Drive a culture of curiosity and learning across the system, acting as the clear, influential voice of the consumer and shopper to senior leadership and bottler partners.
  5. Contribute to the Regional Human Insights Network
    • Share learnings, frameworks, and best practices with the LATAM Insights organization to enhance regional capability.
    • Bring country‑level trends, signals, and insights to the OU to inform broader strategic decisions.
    • Represent Coca‑Cola as a thought leader in consumer and shopper understanding, internally and externally when appropriate.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Behavioral Sciences, Analytics, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in Consumer Insights, Shopper Insights, Market Research, Analytics, Category Management, or Innovation within CPG or related industries.
  • Deep understanding of LATAM retail environments, with strong experience in Traditional Trade, Modern Trade, On‑Premise, and digital channels.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive decisions across complex, matrixed, multi‑market organizations.
  • Strong expertise in Nielsen, Kantar/Worldpanel, shopper data, and proprietary research platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with advanced analytics, AI/ML applications, and next‑gen insights ecosystems.
  • Exceptional storytelling, data visualization, and fact‑based selling skills.
  • Strong people leadership capabilities with a track record of building and inspiring diverse teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, operate with autonomy, and thrive in ambiguity.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish or Portuguese; proficiency in all three is a strong advantage.

What We Can Do for You

  • Iconic Brands in Critical Markets: Lead insights for Coca‑Cola’s two largest and most influential markets in Latin America.
  • Enterprise Level Impact: Shape decisions that influence brands, customers, bottlers, and millions of consumers every day.
  • Exposure to World‑Class Leadership: Partner with Mexico, Brazil, LATAM, and Global leaders across marketing, strategy, and insights.
  • Growth & Learning Culture: Be part of a learning organization that values curiosity, innovation, and bold thinking.

Isso permeia a maneira como recrutamos, desenvolvemos os colaboradores, conduzimos os negócios, apoiamos os clientes e fazemos parcerias com fornecedores. É a forma A&M de ser.

Empregador de Oportunidades Iguais

É prática da Alvarez & Marsal fornecer e promover oportunidades iguais em emprego, compensação e outras condições de trabalho, sem discriminação por raça, cor, credo, religião, origem nacional, ascendência, status de cidadania, sexo ou gênero, identidade de gênero ou expressão de gênero (incluindo status de pessoa transgênero), orientação sexual, estado civil, serviço militar e status de veterano, deficiência física ou mental, histórico médico familiar, informações genéticas ou qualquer outra condição médica protegida, afiliação política ou qualquer outra característica protegida por e em conformidade com as leis aplicáveis. Colaboradores e Candidatos podem encontrar as declarações de política da A&M e informações adicionais por região aqui.

Currículos Não Solicitados de Recrutadores de Terceiros

Informamos que, conforme a política da A&M, não aceitamos currículos não solicitados de recrutadores de terceiros, a menos que esses recrutadores sejam contratados para fornecer candidatos para uma vaga específica e em alinhamento com nossos valores de Diversidade Inclusiva. Qualquer agência de emprego, pessoa ou entidade que envie um currículo não solicitado o faz com o entendimento de que a A&M terá o direito de contratar esse candidato a seu critério, sem que haja qualquer taxa devida à agência de emprego, pessoa ou entidade que tenha enviado o currículo.
