description:
Quem Somos

A Burson é líder global em comunicação estratégica, focada em construir e fortalecer a reputação de seus clientes para gerar valor. Com equipes altamente especializadas, tecnologias de ponta e mentes criativas e inovadoras, ajudamos marcas e empresas a transformar sua reputação em uma vantagem competitiva duradoura. Ao se juntar à Burson, você integrará uma comunidade global de profissionais em constante aprendizado, que prosperam na vanguarda da inovação.

Who We Are

Burson is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

Burson is part of WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP), the creative transformation company. For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Mais Sobre a Posição

A Jeffrey procura um(a) Executivo(a) de Contas Pleno para impulsionar o desenvolvimento e a execução de estratégias de comunicação para clientes no setor Institucional/Indústria Pesada. O(A) profissional terá a oportunidade de participar de projetos desafiadores, contribuir para o crescimento da agência e desenvolver suas habilidades em um ambiente colaborativo e de constante aprendizado.

O Que Você Fará

  • Relacionamento com o cliente (interfaces diretas e consultoria estratégica)
  • Produção de conteúdo para a imprensa, incluindo notas, press releases e cases
  • Manutenção de contato e relacionamento com a imprensa do setor de indústria pesada
  • Apoio na produção e sugestões de pautas, além de follow-up ativo com jornalistas
  • Apoio no desenvolvimento de planos estratégicos integrados de comunicação
  • Monitoramento e identificação de oportunidades, online e offline, para dar visibilidade à marca
  • Produção de relatórios periódicos com insights relevantes
  • Organização e criação de conteúdo para eventos relacionados ao setor

Experiência Que Contribui Para o Sucesso

  • Formação completa em Relações Públicas e/ou Jornalismo
  • Inglês avançado – necessário para reuniões, apresentações, produção de reports e planejamentos
  • Experiência em clientes de grande porte de Indústria Pesada será um diferencial
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro

Benefícios

  • Day Off no aniversário
  • Um short day por mês
  • Horário flexível e modelo híbrido de trabalho

Você Pertence a Burson

Nossa visão é que a Burson seja a principal 'empresa acadêmica' para profissionais de comunicação criativa e líderes emergentes. Oferecemos um ambiente dinâmico e estimulante, onde talentos ambiciosos aprimoram suas habilidades, expandem suas redes e criam as melhores soluções para marcas líderes. Nosso compromisso com o seu desenvolvimento se reflete em programas robustos de benefícios e desenvolvimento de pessoas, incluindo oportunidades de crescimento profissional, mentoria com líderes do setor, uma cultura vibrante e inclusiva que fomenta a colaboração e a inovação, e pacotes de remuneração e benefícios competitivos para atrair e reter os melhores talentos. Investimos em nossos colaboradores porque acreditamos que o sucesso deles é fundamental para o nosso sucesso.

Na Burson, valorizamos o aprendizado contínuo. Entendemos que a excelência em criatividade e comunicação exige um profundo conhecimento e compreensão diferenciada. Por isso, buscamos ativamente talentos excepcionais de diversas origens e identidades. Essa diversidade é essencial para inspirar ideias ousadas, promover diálogos construtivos, criar experiências significativas e impulsionar a inovação para nossos clientes. Seu ponto de vista único – seu talento – é o que define uma #BursonPerson e nos permite, juntos, entregar resultados excepcionais.

Ao clicar em "Enviar inscrição", você compartilhará as informações fornecidas com a Burson. Recomendamos que você leia nossa Política de Privacidade de Recrutamento antes de prosseguir. Residentes da Califórnia devem consultar também o Aviso de Privacidade de Recrutamento da Califórnia. Esses documentos explicam como utilizamos seus dados pessoais durante o processo seletivo, como você pode atualizá‑los ou solicitá‑los a sua exclusão.

You Belong At Burson

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn‑it‑alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent— is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Número de 1936, com a inauguração da nossa fábrica de Santa Helena, na cidade de Votorantim, no interior de São Paulo. Durante quase um século de existência, expandimos nossos negócios e mercados, cruzamos fronteiras e hoje somos uma das maiores empresas do setor no mundo. Atualmente, estamos presentes na América do Norte, América do Sul, Europa, Ásia e Afríca. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que faz, que acredita, que constrói. Conheça nossas unidades de negócio:

A Engemix é a unidade de negócio de concreto da Votorantim Cimentos. Fundada em 1968, a Engemix firmou-se como referência em qualidade de concreto. Com mais de 40 centrais de concreto estrategicamente posicionadas em todo o território brasileiro, ao longo de sua trajetória a marca Engemix participou das principais obras do Brasil, como o Aeroporto de Guarulhos e a Ponte Estaiada, ambas no Estado de São Paulo; a Arena do Grêmio, localizada em Porto Alegre (RS); o Parque Eólico, em Aracati (CE); o Parque Olímpico, localizado no Rio de Janeiro (RJ); e a Arena Pernambuco, no Recife (PE). Mais informações no site: .

A Viter é unidade de insumos agrícolas da Votorantim Cimentos. A marca é líder em comercialização de calcário agrícola no Brasil e a única com presença nacional. Com o propósito de despertar e perpetuar o potencial máximo do solo, seus produtos têm origem garantida e a marca disponibiliza assistência técnica para análise e entendimento do solo. A Viter atua com cinco linhas de produtos: Calcário ITAÉ Fyller e convencional; Calfértil, que são óxidos de cálcio e magnésio; Optmix, mistura homogénea e industrializada de calcário e gesso; Sungard, protetor solar para folhas e frutos; e Granumax V, fertilizante granulado. Mais informações no site .

A Verdera é a unidade de administração e destinação sustentável de resíduos da Votorantim Cimentos. Desde 1991, a empresa atua com coprocessamento e foi pioneira em trazer essa técnica para o Brasil. A Verdera atua na cadeia de soluções ambientais dando um novo valor para os resíduos. É um parceiro com alta capacidade de realização, que entende as particularidades de cada negócio e que está comprometido a fazer do jeito certo e a pensar de forma diferente para descobrir novas possibilidades que transformem a realidade de todos. We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital‑first businesses, including neo‑banks, fast‑moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast‑growing business. With full‑year revenues exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows and fund our growth independently—continuously investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass‑consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose‑built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own telecommunications offerings.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios , 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world‑class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1GLOBAL, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non‑functional and functional state‑of‑the‑art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card —R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica —50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave —180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old —R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

title: Jr. Operations Project Manager - Brazil
description:
Looking for the opportunity to kick start your career? Are you excited about a job that comes with responsibilities from day one, but also requires you to go out into the field and roll up your sleeves? And do you want to learn how to manage a complete project cycle and build meaningful customer relationships in the meantime? Then you have come to the right place! Ampelmann is looking for a Jr. Operations Project Manager to join the team in Brazil. Interested? Read more on the role below and find out how to apply!

Ampelmann makes offshore access as easy as crossing the street. Driven by innovative technology, we are continuously working on impactful projects, while supporting the shift to cleaner energy. Our international and safety‑minded environment values your well‑being, and our culture is built on open communication and mutual respect. With us, you’ll thrive in a fast‑growing, global company with endless opportunities for personal and professional development. Working for Ampelmann truly makes a difference!

Read more about Ampelmann here and have an ‘inside look’ here. About the Operations Americas (AC) team The Operations AC team is part of the Operations Department and is divided over 3 locations: Houston (USA), Providence (USA) and Rio de Janeiro (Brazil). The US team currently consists of a Team Lead Maintenance, 3 Operations Project Managers, 2 Maintenance Technicians, 2 OCC engineers and 1 Team Lead crew. The team in Brazil consists of 2 Project Managers, a Maintenance Technician and a Crew Change Coordinator. The team is led from Houston by the Operations Area Manager. As a Junior Operations Project Manager, you will have a high degree of responsibility from day one but will receive the necessary coaching and guidance from more experienced Operations Project Managers. The position is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

Your role as Jr. Operations Project Manager

As Jr. Operations Project Manager, you are the internal and external point of contact for projects in your region where an Ampelmann system is deployed offshore. For each project you are responsible for the entire project cycle, from the preparation to close‑out phase. Your goal is to finish each project on time, and within scope and budget, resulting in a satisfied client. You do this by optimizing the project, visiting clients, visiting the operation, and executing a flawless project administration. Next to this, you are also responsible for coaching the operators that man the systems offshore.

Regular activities

  • Managing daily project operations and liaising with both internal and external stakeholders on all aspects of your projects.
  • Preparing, coordinating, and executing (de)mobilisations of systems, attending offshore trials and performing satisfactory client visits.
  • Analyzing operational challenges, and preparing and executing proposed solutions.
  • Responsible for setting up a project plan and taking care of all project administration (budgeting, invoicing, and purchasing).
  • Occasionally getting your hands dirty, e.g. in coverall on a yard when work on the system is performed in preparation of a project.

We ask

  • Higher Vocational Education/BSc/MSc degree (any technical study, e.g., Technical Business Administration) and 0-2 years relevant work experience.
  • Excellent English and Portuguese communication skills, both spoken and written.
  • Willingness to travel (30-40% of the work is performed on site).
  • Affinity with project management.
  • Analytical skills, high degree of responsibility and accountability, and a pro‑active attitude.

You get

  • A great work environment with innovative and change‑willing aspirations.
  • High degree of responsibility, room to grow, and room to have significant impact.
  • Monthly gross salary between BRL 5.226 and BRL 7.466, based on your experience.
  • Great secondary benefits (e.g., annual bonus, working from home policy, unlimited vacation days, and more).
  • Ampelmann Academy for all your personal and professional development needs.

Interested?

You can apply until 5 March 2026 by uploading your CV via the “Apply” button on our website. In the week after the closing date, we will let you know if you have been selected for the first interview round. If there is a match after the first interview, you will proceed to the second interview round. Still a match? Then we will offer you the job!

Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting). Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance. Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services. Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers. Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs. Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. title: Analista De Seguros Júnior -Vaga Exclusiva Para Pcd
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Atividades: Realizar atendimentos aos clientes, respondendo a dúvidas, fornecendo informações e auxiliando em suas necessidades. Verificar a conformidade dos processos de atendimento de acordo com as diretrizes e padrões estabelecidos. Auxiliar na identificação de melhorias com base nos registros de atendimentos. Colaborar com as equipes de atendimento e outras áreas para resolver problemas. Acompanhar métricas e elaborar relatórios e apresentações. Prestar suporte em cotações de seguros. Controlar e resolver pendências de propostas e apólices de seguros. Monitorar a regulação de sinistros. Atualizar sistemas internos e planilhas de controle. Requisitos: Ensino Superior completo. Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel. Excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita. Proatividade, com capacidade de antecipar etapas e considerar possíveis desdobramentos. Experiência no mercado de seguros. Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e atividades administrativas. Nossos benefícios: Vale Refeição/Alimentação;

Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria. Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis. Negociação e fechamento Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis. Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita. Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais. Metas e indicadores (referência) Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços). Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas. Taxa de conversão e ticket médio. Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline. Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região. Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais. Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades. Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis. Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades. Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial. Suporte da Mobiis Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento. Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas. Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas. Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Business Integration Specialist
description: About You You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners. You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined. You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. 3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms. Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools. Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows. Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage. Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners. Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously within self-managed Agile teams. Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency. Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Full professional proficiency in English. Familiarity with Azure cloud environments. Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers. Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do). You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners. Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests. Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support. Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps. Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment. Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities. Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives. Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies. Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations. Qualifications Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure DevOps / Jira), defect triage, and production support. Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency. Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Calypso Configuration And Environment Management
description:
Crypto Venture AnalystCompany: Meta MartianLocation: Brazil (Remote)Department: Investment & ResearchCompensation StrategySalary Range: $70,000 – $100,000 USD / year We pay in USD or USDC. This compensation package is explicitly benchmarked to the top 1% of the Brazilian venture capital market. We believe in rewarding high-conviction insights, not just hours worked.The Investment Mandate and Regional FocusMeta Martian is deploying capital into the builders who are re-architecting the internet. We are seeking a Crypto Venture Analyst based in Brazil to act as our eyes and ears in the LATAM market-one of the fastest-growing crypto adoption zones in the world. Your mandate is to identify high-signal opportunities before they hit the mainstream radar. You are not here to follow the herd;
you are here to build the thesis that the herd will eventually follow. You will be dissecting early-stage protocols, connecting with founders in São Paulo, Rio, and Buenos Aires, and feeding high-quality deal flow into our global investment committee.Due Diligence and Deal Flow MechanicsThis role is the engine of our decision-making process. You will lead the rigorous "under the hood" inspection of potential investments. This goes far beyond reading a pitch deck. We expect you to scrutinize the technical architecture, challenge the founders on their go-to-market assumptions, and verify the integrity of their team. You will manage the entire deal funnel: from the first coffee meeting with a founder to writing the final Investment Memo that convinces our partners to sign a check. You must be comfortable asking uncomfortable questions to protect our capital.Thesis Generation and Tokenomics ForensicsWe do not invest in "vibes." We invest in sustainable mechanics. A core part of your role is Tokenomic Stress-Testing. You will take a project's proposed token distribution and model it out over 5 years. You must answer critical questions: Does the token capture value? Is the inflation schedule predatory? Is the FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) realistic compared to competitors? You will produce deep-dive sector research-whether on DePIN, Zero-Knowledge proofs, or RWA-that shapes our firm's view on where the market is heading over the next cycle.What We Are Not Looking For (The Anti-Persona)To respect your time, let us define what this role is not:- Not a "Spray and Pray" Investor: We are a high-conviction fund. If you like throwing small checks at every meme coin, this is not for you.- Not a Passive Observer: If you wait for deals to come to your inbox, you will fail. We need a hunter who is active in the developer trenches.- Not a Chart Watcher: This is a Venture Capital role (Seed/Series A), not a liquid hedge fund role. We do not care about daily price action;
we care about multi-year technology horizons.The Analyst Archetype- You are deeply embedded in the crypto culture. You likely have a "degen" past but a professional present. You are fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus). You have a network of developers and builders in Brazil who trust you. You are intellectually honest-you are willing to kill your own favorite deal if the data shows it is a bad investment. You combine the networking skills of a BD manager with the analytical rigor of a mathematician.

title: Coordenador De Contabilidade
description:
Buscamos um profissional para atuar como COORDENADOR CONTÁBIL em um provedor de serviços logísticos no Brasil e no Exterior. Será responsável por liderar e organizar as atividades das áreas Contábil e Fiscal, garantindo o cumprimento de metas, prazos e conformidade com normas e legislações. Atuar na orientação técnica a clientes internos, coordenar auditorias externas e fiscalizações, conduzir o fechamento contábil e assegurar o compliance fiscal das empresas do grupo. REQUISITOS Formação Superior Completa em Ciências Contábeis com CRC ativo. Desejável Pós Graduação em Controladoria / Finanças / Gestão Tributária. Inglês intermediário, desejável avançado. 5 anos de experiência profissional em empresas multinacionais e/ou nacionais. Conhecimento de apuração de todos os tributos e entrega de obrigações acessórias munipais, estaduais e federais. Experiência em planejamento tributário. Experiência em revisão e elaboração de conciliação, análise de contas patrimoniais e resultado. Experiência no preparo de demonstrações financeiras e caderno de auditoria, demonstrações financeiras base para publicação. Conhecimento e aplicação das normas contábeis vigentes e revisão de demonstrações financeiras para a companhia de valores imobiliários. Conhecimento e aplicação normas contábeis e IFRS. Desejável conhecimento operacional módulo contábil: FI/CO - ERP SAP. Desejável conhecimento em sistema fiscal (cockpit SAP). Excel avançado. Foco no cliente internos e apoio à boa gestão da empresa. RESPONSABILIDADES: Atender amplamente a auditoria externa, analisando as solicitações, esclarecendo contabilizações, controlando cronogramas e demandas, garantindo que as demonstrações reproduzam fielmente a situação fiscal, contábil e financeira. Desenvolver equipes fiscal e contábil promovendo a sinergia das áreas, visando a ampliação do conhecimento dos colaboradores. Aprovar conciliações de todas as contas contábeis mantendo as principais em dia evitando divergências com auditoria externa ou não cumprimento das normas contábeis e fiscais vigentes. Distribuir e implementar plano de ação carta de controles internos de auditoria externa, para redução ou mitigação dos pontos no próximo período. Revisar e garantir a entrega de todas as obrigações junto aos orgãos Ferderais, Estaduais e municipais. Aprovar e acompanhar as rotinas de encerramento de exercício e melhorias em sistemas, avançando em melhores práticas de controles fiscais e contábeis. Prestar orientação contábil e fiscal para os clientes internos relativo ao caderno de auditoria, operações, legislação vigente ou demais situações técnicas para a correta aplicação e não exposição da empresa. Transmitir as informações a usuários e órgãos reguladores,. Aprovar lançamentos provenientes de reorganização societária para atendimento a normas vigentes. Elaborar comentário sobre desempenho e relatório da diretoria nas demonstrações Financeiras auditadas;
Assegurar a entrega no prazo e correta de todas as obrigações acessórias nas diversas esferas tributárias, garantindo o compliance fiscal. Assegurar que as operações fiscais da organização estejam ocorrendo em conformidade com a legislação fiscal corrente evitando autuações, multas e sanções. Analisar e buscar o aproveitamento dos créditos tributários obtidos pela empresa, por meio de compensações, restituições ou transferência para outras unidades, contribuindo para a melhora no caixa e resultado. Orientar e transmitir à equipe fiscal as mudanças ocorridas na legislação fiscal, por meio de instruções e informativos, garantindo que todos os colaboradores estejam atualizados. Decidir com segurança e clareza sobre questões dúbias ou polêmicas referente a tributação, por meio de análise criteriosa da legislação vigente, buscando evitar os riscos de passivo. Contribuir no adequado fechamento contábil, validando saldos contábeis a pagar e a recuperar de tributos. Identificar oportunidades de redução na carga fiscal, discutindo interna e externamente sobre possibilidades decorrentes do nosso negócio ou posicionamento dos fiscos e tribunais. Assegurar que todos os registros fiscais sejam efetuados dentro do período de competência, através da de controles das atividades e dos relatórios de apuração extraídos do sistema. Coordenar o atendimento aos processos de fiscalização, auditorias internas e externa ocorridos na empresa. REMUNERAÇÃO: Pacote atraente, com Bônus diferenciado e Benefícios completos! LOCAL DE TRABALHO: Rio de Janeiro, RJ

title: Tecnico(A) Implantação Ii

Disponibilidade de viagem para atender projetos em outros estados, seguindo a política de viagens estabelecido pela empresa. Conhecer, entender e seguir as políticas e procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Convergint com foco em Qualidade, Segurança da Informação Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno. Propor melhorias para os processos e serviços visando manter e melhorar continuamente a Qualidade dos serviços, Segurança da Informação e Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno, incluindo participação na identificação e determinação de ações para minimização e controle dos riscos relacionados. Conectorização de cabos (RJ45, Keystone e Terminais elétricos);
Instalação de Dispositivos eletrônicos de BMS, SDAI e SECURITY;
Montagem de Rede de cabeamento estruturado (RCE);

Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Um profissional que consiga ser um gestor de projetos eficaz, garantindo que a obra:

  • Seja segura e legal.

  • Minimize o transtorno causado pela obra.

As principais funções do síndico no contexto de obras são:

  • Garantir a Segurança e a Conformidade Legal
    Exigir o cumprimento da NBR 16.280 e do regimento interno do condomínio em todas as reformas, seja nas áreas comuns ou nas unidades privativas.
    Zelar pela conservação e segurança da edificação (Art. 1.348, V, do Código Civil), responsabilizando‑se por qualquer dano causado por negligência na fiscalização.

    Manter a documentação da obra arquivada.
Requisitos
  • I. Requisitos Técnicos e Legais
    • Conhecimento da NBR 16.280: É obrigatório que o síndico conheça a fundo a norma que trata da Gestão de Reformas em Edificações.

    • Domínio do Código Civil (Obras): conhecer os quóruns de aprovação de obras (Artigos 1.341 a 1.343).
    • Habilidade em Análise de Documentos: analisar e arquivar corretamente ARTs, RRTs, laudos de inspeção, contratos e garantias.
    • Gestão de Contratos: conhecer aspectos essenciais de contratos de empreitada/serviço.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer to join Petroleum Engineering/Oil Reservoir Management Department.

Petroleum Engineering/Oil Reservoir Management Department is responsible for developing and managing world-class fields, reservoirs, and reserves, leveraging cutting‑edge technology and innovation at our state‑of‑the‑art Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. Our organization also conducts pioneering research, introduces new technologies, and provides engineering services as part of our customized reservoir management practices.

As an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer your primary role is to serve as an expert in Oil Reservoir Management, providing guidance and expert advice to the design, implementation, and optimization of best‑in‑class reservoir management programs for the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields. The position is embedded within Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical role, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide expert guidance and oversight on best‑in‑class reservoir management principles, practices, and cutting‑edge technologies across all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance, and monitoring of masterplans to optimize asset development and depletion strategies. This involves utilizing established reservoir management standards and guidelines to
  • Maximize Net Present Value (NPV) and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and practice in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare critical reservoir engineering inputs for drilling and workover proposals and programs, recommending innovative completion techniques for complex well configurations, including: horizontal and multilateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies focused on optimizing ultimate recovery through reservoir stimulation modeling of various Improved Oil Recovery (IOR) processes.
  • Engage in professional development activities, such as: participating in technical societies and groups, sharing expertise, and mentoring young engineers to foster growth and excellence within the organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering or a related Engineering discipline from an accredited university. Advanced degree is a plus.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management.
  • Training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected.
  • Knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures-strategy‑technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis, and fluid's compatibility.
  • Expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are preferred.
  • History of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector‑specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a unique position in the global energy industry. We are the world’s largest producer of hydrocarbons (oil and gas), with the lowest upstream carbon intensity of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generational spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como os serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.

  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.

  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.

  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.

  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.

While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

This role reports to the CISO.

What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness

Optional things we value

  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

A Ortobom iniciou suas atividades em 1969, fabricando camas e mesas de metal. Atenta às novas tendências, a empresa passou a comprar blocos de espuma para a confecção de colchões, que harmoniosamente se casavam com as camas.

Em 1975, a Ortobom inaugurou no Rio de Janeiro a primeira fábrica especializada na fabricação de colchões. O objetivo era a produção e comercialização de colchões que proporcionassem o máximo de bem-estar e conforto aos clientes.

O sonho virou realidade. Hoje a Ortobom possui 12 fábricas e 400.000 m2 de área construída. São mais de 2.000 lojas no Brasil, com filiais também na Bolívia, Uruguai e Paraguai. O setor fabril, se somado, tem uma área superior a de grandes montadoras de automóveis.

A Ortobom é a maior produtora de colchões da América Latina e a 2ª maior produtora de espuma do mundo.

A qualidade é garantida através de um investimento constante em tecnologia, desde a matéria-prima ao maquinário. Toda essa estrutura só é possível graças ao potencial humano: são mais de 6.000 colaboradores, 1.000 franqueados e 5.000 consultores em todo o Brasil.
